fato_historico: 1555: The Peace of Augsburg is signed by Emperor Charles V and the princes of the Schmalkaldic League.

Consider opening your heart to reconciliation and watch how your path forward clears with grace and ease.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the courageous pursuit of lasting peace and mutual understanding.
